name: IntegrateIT Shelly
notes: Local-LAN control for a single Shelly component (relay/switch or roller/cover) over the on-device HTTP API — Gen2+ JSON-RPC or Gen1 REST, auto-detected. Turn On/Off/Toggle a switch or Open/Close/Stop/Go-To-Position a cover, with polled state published as variables and events. No Shelly Cloud account required. MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
